name: cogmemai-mcp
description: CogmemAi is the smart, safe, persistent memory that keeps Ai in line. It remembers what matters across every session, keeps the work in scope with a plain-English intent document, stops any action that breaks the rules you set before it happens, reviews what your Ai did against what you asked for, and tunes its own recall with use. Rule packs: npx cogmemai-mcp rules install devsecops loads forty DevSecOps rules (secrets, infrastructure as code, least privilege, CI/CD gates, change control, data, logging, incident response) that stop risky shell commands before they run, judge plain-English actions, and review each turn against the project's intent. Voice: npx cogmemai-mcp voice learn <files> measures your own writing and stores your voice as rules, so every connected Ai writes like you, and voice check gates a draft before it goes out. Persistent memory, scope, guardrails, quality reviews and self-tuning recall for any Ai system through MCP, REST and SDKs.
author: HiFriendbot (https://hifriendbot.com)
